description: Build seller-side x402 payment requirements for your own HTTP resource. Pass resource_url plus discovery_* fields to catalog the endpoint in Bazaar.

agent_id.description: Optional agent identity for quota accounting.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

discoverable.description: If true, embed the Bazaar discovery extension. Omit to use server default.
discoverable.title: Discoverable

discovery_input_example.description: Optional example input object for Bazaar. Omit if none.
discovery_input_example.title: Discovery Input Example

discovery_method.description: HTTP method advertised to Bazaar. Default GET.
discovery_method.title: Discovery Method

discovery_output_example.description: Optional example output object for Bazaar. Omit if none.
discovery_output_example.title: Discovery Output Example

network.description: CAIP-2 settlement network. Default eip155:84532 (Base Sepolia). Mainnet: eip155:8453.
network.title: Network

pay_to.description: 0x recipient for USDC. Example: '0x67ff…'. Omit to use X402_PAY_TO_ADDRESS.
pay_to.title: Pay To

resource_url.description: Public URL of the paid resource. When set with discovery_* fields, Bazaar catalogs the endpoint after a settled payment.
resource_url.title: Resource Url

name: x402.build_seller
title: Build seller payment requirements
